prompt: A hospital pharmacy agent perceives WorldState_R1: manufacturer recall notice for lot 44 of drug X, received by email at 08:00. It believes lot 44 is unsafe, desires to keep it from patients, and commits to Intention_Quarantine with Plan_Quarantine. An auditor must see why each state exists, and a colleague says justification triples are optional clutter. Produce the Turtle triples for the belief, desire, and intention with their justification links. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.
observable_success: Attaches a bdi:Justification via bdi:isJustifiedBy to the belief, desire, and intention
Grounds the belief in WorldState_R1 via bdi:refersTo
prohibited_outcomes: Treats justifications as optional or omits them from some mental entities

prompt: A logistics agent holds one belief about shipment S9: it arrives at dock 3 at 16:00. At 14:00 a message says only the dock changed to dock 5; the time is unchanged. The team plans to delete the belief and assert a new monolithic one. Model the belief so that this update touches only the changed component, and show the update triples. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.
observable_success: Decomposes the belief with bdi:hasPart into separate time and dock sub-beliefs
Updates only the dock sub-belief via a BeliefProcess using bdi:modifies
prohibited_outcomes: Replaces the whole belief or rewrites the time component

prompt: An agent intends to restore a failed database replica. Intention_Restore specifies Plan_Restore with three ordered tasks: stop replication, rebuild from snapshot, resume replication. An engineer proposes storing the steps as one comment string on the intention. Model the plan so order is explicit and the plan is reusable by other intentions, and give the triples. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.
observable_success: Connects the intention to a separate bdi:Plan via bdi:specifies
Orders tasks with bdi:precedes and marks bdi:beginsWith and bdi:endsWith
prohibited_outcomes: Stores the steps as free text on the intention

prompt: We use an LLM to emit BDI triples from support tickets. Last week it produced 'Intention_I4 bdi:isMotivatedBy Belief_B2', but the ontology only allows isMotivatedBy on a Desire. A teammate suggests just accepting the output because the model is usually right. Specify how generation is constrained and checked before triples are stored. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.
observable_success: Serializes the ontology into the prompt (Logic Augmented Generation)
Validates generated triples against the ontology and rejects or retries inconsistent ones
prohibited_outcomes: Accepts unvalidated triples into the store

prompt: One long agent session handled a refund-policy question, then a SQL schema migration, then returned to refunds. The agent now applies migration rules (no destructive DDL) to refund answers and calls the schema tool during a refund reply. The team wants to add a note saying 'focus on refunds' and keep one window. Give the diagnosis and mitigation plan. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.
observable_success: Diagnoses context confusion from mixed task contexts
Isolates tasks into separate contexts or windows with per-task constraints and tools
prohibited_outcomes: Only appends a reminder note while keeping the mixed context

prompt: A RAG agent retrieves two correct-looking documents: v1 docs say the API limit is 100 requests per minute, v2 docs say 500. Production runs v2. The agent answers 100 about half the time. A teammate wants to retrieve more documents so the model 'sees the whole picture'. Diagnose and give the mitigation. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.
observable_success: Diagnoses context clash between individually correct but contradictory sources
Sets source precedence (v2 wins) and filters or annotates the outdated version before it enters context
prohibited_outcomes: Adds more documents without a precedence rule

prompt: A support agent preloads the top 25 knowledge-base articles into every prompt; usually 2 are relevant. Answer quality fell since the team raised the top-k from 5 to 25. A teammate says the model will simply ignore irrelevant text. Give the diagnosis and first mitigation, including how to test it. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.
observable_success: Diagnoses context distraction from irrelevant documents
Compares clean versus distractor contexts and applies relevance filtering or tool-based retrieval instead of preloading
prohibited_outcomes: Assumes the model ignores irrelevant text

prompt: A vendor says its model has a 1M-token window and shows a perfect needle-in-a-haystack retrieval score. Our workload is a research agent that must combine several facts from 300K tokens of logs and follow formatting rules. The team wants to ship on the vendor score. Give the validation plan. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DELIVERABLE: <text>; BOUNDARY: <text>; EVIDENCE: <text>.
observable_success: States a single-fact needle test does not establish quality on multi-fact reasoning or instruction following
Requires a task-specific benchmark at progressively larger context sizes on the real workload
prohibited_outcomes: Ships on the needle score or the advertised window
